vetSays.line: 🛡️ Darius, Jack, Bessie, Aki and Vasyl met them at the door — 5 put down. Darius, Jack, Bessie, Aki, Vasyl are hurt.
🛡️ Thabo, Vasyl, Nadia and Miguel met them at the door — 4 put down. Thabo, Vasyl, Miguel are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Julio just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Darius just put down Ugly-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Thabo just put down Ugly-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nadia just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Darius, Thabo, Vasyl and Nadia met them at the door — 4 put down. Darius, Thabo, Vasyl, Nadia are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Darius just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Darius, Liezl and Thabo met them at the door — 3 put down. Darius, Liezl, Thabo are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Thabo just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Liezl just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Thabo just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Darius, Bessie, Liezl and Thabo met them at the door — 4 put down. Darius, Bessie, Liezl, Thabo are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Thabo just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Darius, Bessie, Liezl and Thabo met them at the door — 4 put down. Darius, Bessie, Liezl, Thabo are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Santiago just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Naran just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Elijah, Naran and Santiago met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Elijah, Naran, Santiago are hurt.
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
Blooded — the village knows where the Producers bleed. (Strikes hit 1.5× as hard; their blows land at 0.75× strength.)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Miguel just put down The Timeslot... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Darius just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
🛡️ Antônia met them at the door — 1 put down. Antônia is hurt.
